# Journal of Childhood, Education & Society

> An open-access, peer-reviewed interdisciplinary journal publishing research on childhood education under Creative Commons licensing.

JCES (ISSN 2717-638X) is built on the Open Journal Systems (OJS) platform and welcomes submissions on childhood education topics from researchers and practitioners worldwide. The journal maintains rigorous editorial standards while ensuring open access to published research.

## Key Topics

- Journal of Childhood, Education & Society (JCES)
- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review Process
